speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old college student. The patient is here for a follow-up appointment. He was recently diagnosed with schizophrenia and started on risperidone approximately 2 months ago. Reports a significant improvement in psychiatric symptoms since the start of treatment.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug-induced Parkinsonism (Secondary Parkinsonism)

Based on your history of starting risperidone two months ago and the subsequent onset of movement issues, this is highly suggestive of a medication side effect. Can you describe the specific quality of these movements—such as tremors, stiffness, or shuffling gait—and whether they affect your ability to perform daily tasks?
